answer: Make the income check impossible to skip and review past loans without one: [F3] of sampled loans had no verified income, and those loans are in arrears far more often.

situation: An online lender whose rules and policy require verified income on every loan.
complication: Staff can skip the income check, and many sampled loans have none.
key_question: Does the lender meet the verified-income requirement, and what must change?

titles.roadmap: Stop new gaps first, then review past loans.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the gap is closed.
titles.risks: The main risk is customers harmed by unaffordable loans.
